#outlier functions
```{r}
#if the data is not normally distributed but symmetric, we recalculate the b-value
compute_b_value <- function(x) {
  # Normalize the data (z-score)
  z <- (x - mean(x, na.rm=TRUE)) / sd(x, na.rm=TRUE)
  # Get the 75th percentile
  Q75 <- quantile(z, 0.75,na.rm=TRUE)
  # Compute b value
  b_value <- 1 / Q75
  return(b_value)
}
```

```{r}
#for not normal and asymmetric data, run DoubleMad
DoubleMAD <- function(x, zero.mad.action="warn"){
   # The zero.mad.action determines the action in the event of an MAD of zero.
   # Possible values: "stop", "warn", "na" and "warn and na".
   x         <- x[!is.na(x)]
   m         <- median(x)
   abs.dev   <- abs(x - m)
   left.mad  <- median(abs.dev[x<=m])
   right.mad <- median(abs.dev[x>=m])
   if (left.mad == 0 || right.mad == 0){
      if (zero.mad.action == "stop") stop("MAD is 0")
      if (zero.mad.action %in% c("warn", "warn and na")) warning("MAD is 0")
      if (zero.mad.action %in% c(  "na", "warn and na")){
         if (left.mad  == 0) left.mad  <- NA
         if (right.mad == 0) right.mad <- NA
      }
   }
   return(c(left.mad, right.mad))
}

DoubleMADsFromMedian <- function(x, zero.mad.action="warn"){
   # The zero.mad.action determines the action in the event of an MAD of zero.
   # Possible values: "stop", "warn", "na" and "warn and na".
   two.sided.mad <- DoubleMAD(x, zero.mad.action)
   m <- median(x, na.rm=TRUE)
   x.mad <- rep(two.sided.mad[1], length(x))
   x.mad[x > m] <- two.sided.mad[2]
   mad.distance <- abs(x - m) / x.mad
   mad.distance[x==m] <- 0
   return(mad.distance)
}

#outlier=print(x[DoubleMADsFromMedian(x) > 3])


```

#outlier detection


#MLU
```{r}

lab.mlu <- (read.csv("Processed Data/Level1_output/labonly_MLU.csv"))[,-1]
seg.mlu <- (read.csv("Processed Data/Level1_output/segonly_MLU.csv"))[,-1]

```

```{r}
shapiro.test(lab.mlu$MLU_ave)#normal
a=outliers_mad(lab.mlu$MLU_ave,b=1.4826, threshold=3, na.rm=TRUE)
a$outliers_pos#no outlier


shapiro.test(seg.mlu$MLU_ave)#not normal
symmetry.test(seg.mlu$MLU_ave) #not symmetric
result <- seg.mlu$MLU_ave[DoubleMADsFromMedian(seg.mlu$MLU_ave) > 3] #12 outliers,from both ends

#b_val=compute_b_value(seg.mlu$MLU_ave)
#a=outliers_mad(seg.mlu$MLU_ave,b=b_val, threshold=3, na.rm=TRUE)
#a$outliers #lower outlier got skipped, using doubleMAD results
metric_name="MLU_ave"
df=seg.mlu
result_pos=which(seg.mlu$MLU_ave %in% result)
outlier=data.frame( 
  subjectID=df[result_pos,'subjectID'],
  condition=df[result_pos,'condition'],
  metric=rep(metric_name,length(result_pos)),
  outlier_value=unname(df[result_pos,metric_name,drop=TRUE]))
outlier_log <- rbind(outlier_log, outlier)

seg.mlu$MLU_ave[seg.mlu$MLU_ave %in% result] <- NA

```

```{r}
full.mlu <- rbind(lab.mlu, seg.mlu)
write.csv(full.mlu,"Processed Data/Level2_output/mlu_outremoved.csv")
```

##sdt
```{r}
full.lab=full.sdt.agg.all %>% filter(condition=="WithLabel")
full.seg=full.sdt.agg.all %>% filter(condition=="NoLabel")


shapiro.test(full.lab$dprime)#normal
a=outliers_mad(full.lab$dprime,b=1.4826, threshold=3, na.rm=TRUE)
a$outliers_pos#no outlier

shapiro.test(full.lab$c)#not normal
symmetry.test(full.lab$c) #symmetric
b_val=compute_b_value(full.lab$c)
a=outliers_mad(full.lab$c,b=b_val, threshold=3, na.rm=TRUE)
a$outliers_pos#1 outlier

outlier=data.frame( #3 outliers
  subjectID=full.lab[a$outliers_pos,'Participant'],
  condition=full.lab[a$outliers_pos,'condition'],
  metric=rep("c",length(a$outliers_pos)),
  outlier_value=full.lab[a$outliers_pos,'c'])
outlier_log <- rbind(outlier_log, outlier)

full.lab[a$outliers_pos,'c']<-NA



shapiro.test(full.seg$dprime)#normal
a=outliers_mad(full.seg$dprime,b=1.4826, threshold=3, na.rm=TRUE)
a$outliers_pos#no outlier

shapiro.test(full.seg$c)#not normal
symmetry.test(full.seg$c) #symmetric
b_val=compute_b_value(full.seg$c)
a=outliers_mad(full.seg$c,b=b_val, threshold=3, na.rm=TRUE)
a$outliers_pos#3 outlier

outlier=data.frame( #3 outliers
  subjectID=full.seg[a$outliers_pos,'Participant'],
  condition=full.seg[a$outliers_pos,'condition'],
  metric=rep("c",length(a$outliers_pos)),
  outlier_value=full.seg[a$outliers_pos,'c'])
outlier_log <- rbind(outlier_log, outlier)

full.seg[a$outliers_pos,'c']<-NA



```

```{r}
full.sdt=rbind(full.lab,full.seg)
write.csv(full.sdt,"Processed Data/Level2_output/FULL_sdt_agg_metrics_outlierremoved.csv")
```
